181: Within this very house is the wealth of the Name of the boundless Lord.
Within this very house, it is heard, the Banker Himself dwells.
ਕਵਨੁ ਬਾਪਾਰੀ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਊਹਾ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
Rare is the trader whose credit stands in that Banker's presence. ॥1॥
Whoever truly trades in the jewel of God's Name
makes the life-giving food of the Name his sustenance. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I offer him my mind and body and stand ready to serve him.
ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
What is the way by which God may be pleased?
Giving up "mine" and "yours", I fall at his feet.
ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਨੁ; ਜੋ ਸਉਦਾ ਜੋਰੈ ॥੨॥
Who is that servant of God who can strike the bargain of the Name for me? ॥2॥
ਮਹਲੁ ਸਾਹ ਕਾ; ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
By what means does one find the mansion of the Banker?
ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਬਿਧਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
What is the way by which He calls the trader into His presence?
ਤੂੰ ਵਡ ਸਾਹੁ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕੋਟਿ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ॥
You, Lord, are the greatest Banker, and crores of beings are Your traders.
Who is the giver of the Name who will take hold of me and bring me to Your feet? ॥3॥
Searching and searching, the trader finds his own true home,
and the Guru shows him the priceless, everlasting jewel of the Name.
Whenever the Banker, in His mercy, unites a trader with Himself,
Says Nanak: it is on the Guru's surety that He does so. ॥4॥16॥85॥
Night and day he stays absorbed in the love of the one God.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
He knows God to be always close beside him.
He treats the Master's Name as the thing he uses at every moment.
By the sight of God he stays filled and content. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਮਨ ਤਨ ਹਰੇ ॥
Those stay dyed in God, with mind and body in bloom,
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ; ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
who take the shelter of the perfect Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
They keep God's lovely feet as the support of their soul.
They see the One alone everywhere and walk always in His command.
The Name is their only trade, and in it alone they deal.
Apart from the formless Lord they form no deep bond with any other. ॥2॥
They stay free of both joy and sorrow.
Always untouched by Maya, they stay joined to God and live by the right way of life.
ਦੀਸਹਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ; ਸਭ ਤੇ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
They are seen loving all, yet are seen apart from all.
They keep their attention fixed on the supreme God. ॥3॥
What greatness of those saints can I describe?
ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ; ਕਿਛੁ ਮਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
Their height of spirit is beyond understanding, and I cannot gauge it at all.
O supreme God, show me mercy
and grant Nanak the dust of those saints' feet. ॥4॥17॥86॥
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਖਾ; ਤੂੰਹੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
You alone are my companion, You alone my friend.
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ; ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੀਤੁ ॥
You alone are my beloved, and my love is with You alone.
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਤਿ; ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥
You alone are my honour, You alone my ornament.
ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ; ਨਿਮਖੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ਰਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
Without You I cannot last even for the blink of an eye. ॥1॥
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲਨ; ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
You are my dear darling, You are the stay of my life.
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ; ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੇ ਖਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You are my Master, You are my chief. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਉ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ; ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹਨਾ ॥
As You keep me, Lord, so I live.
ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਕਹਹੁ; ਸੋਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
I do only what You command me to do.
Whichever way I look, there I see You dwelling.
With my tongue I keep repeating Your Name, which guards against the world's fears. ॥2॥
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ; ਤੂੰ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
You are the world's nine treasures to me, You are my store.
You are my colours and tastes, You are the prop of my mind.
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚੀਆ ॥
You are my glory, and my attention stays joined to You.
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਓਟ; ਤੂੰ ਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਕੀਆ ॥੩॥
You are my shelter, You alone are my support. ॥3॥
In my mind and heart it is You alone I keep remembering.
Your secret I have found from the Guru.
The one who receives from the Guru the Name of the One alone, to hold firm in the heart,
ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕੈ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੮੭॥
O Nanak, that servant comes to lean always on God's Name alone. ॥4॥18॥87॥
182: In one place there is the spread of joy and sorrow,
in another beings fall into hell or arrive in heaven,
some are rich, some poor, some delight in seeing their own renown,
and elsewhere Maya presses as greed, the root of all ills. ॥1॥
Lord, Maya keeps its hold on beings in many ways,
ਸੰਤ ਜੀਵਹਿ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਓਟ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
but Your saints live the life of the spirit by leaning on You. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One is drunk on the thought of "I, I, me, me".
One is steeped in attachment to children and wife.
One is taken up with elephants, horses and clothes.
One is drunk on beauty and youth: in such ways Maya presses its force. ॥2॥
In one place it is the owning of land, in another the poor, in another the rich,
in another people delighting in songs and music heard in gatherings,
in another the craving for fine beds, adornments and mansions,
and in the darkness of attachment Maya presses as the five foes, lust and the rest. ॥3॥
One, caught in pride, performs his religious deeds.
One is busy as a householder, another lives as a renunciate.
One is busy with religious rites, another with pride of caste.
ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਆਪਤ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਤ ॥੪॥
Without being absorbed in God's love, all of this is only Maya's hold. ॥4॥
ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ; ਕਾਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
God the King Himself cuts the bonds of the saints.
Maya cannot press its force upon them.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਿਨਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਈ ॥
Says Nanak: the one who has gained the dust of the saints' feet,
Maya cannot come near that person. ॥5॥19॥88॥
Looking on another's beauty with a corrupt eye is the sleep that fills the eyes.
The ears stay asleep listening to talk that slanders others.
The tongue stays asleep in greed for food and the sweet taste of things.
The mind stays asleep in the strange show of Maya. ॥1॥
ਇਸੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ; ਕੋਈ ਜਾਗਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
Rare is the one who stays awake in this house of the body.
ਸਾਬਤੁ ਵਸਤੁ; ਓਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He keeps safe the whole of his capital of spiritual life. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
All the senses stay drunk, each on its own pleasure.
ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ; ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
They keep no watch over their own house, the body.
ਉਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ; ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਈ ॥
From them neither father nor mother can save.
ਉਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ; ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
From them neither friend nor brother can save.
They cannot be held back by wealth or by cleverness.
Only by staying in the company of the holy are those five villains brought under control. ॥3॥
O Lord, wielder of the bow, show me mercy.
Give me the dust of the saints' feet, which is every treasure to me.
In the Guru's company the capital of spiritual life stays whole.
Nanak stays awake only by living in the love of the supreme God. ॥4॥
He alone stays awake to whom God Himself is kind.
ਇਹ ਪੂੰਜੀ; ਸਾਬਤੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨੦॥੮੯॥
His capital stays whole, and the wealth of the Name stays with him. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥20॥89॥
The God under whom are khans and sultans,
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ; ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
under whose command is the whole world,
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
by whose doing everything comes about,
against Him no being can turn rebel. ॥1॥
Make your plea to your Guru.
He will bring your life's tasks to completion. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
The God whose court is higher than the court of every king,
ਸਗਲ ਭਗਤ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
whose Name is the support of all devotees,
the Master who holds sway over all and pervades all,
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬਨੀ ॥੨॥
whose beauty shows in every body: remember His Name. ॥2॥
He at whose remembrance every sorrow departs,
ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਜਮੁ. ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥
at whose remembrance the fear of death cannot touch one,
at whose remembrance the pitiless grow tender-hearted,
183: at whose remembrance the stone-hearted are kept from drowning: remember His Name. ॥3॥
Always bow before the company of the holy,
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
for God's Name is the support of the lives of the holy.
Says Nanak: the Creator has heard my prayer,
ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੯੦॥
and by the Guru's grace has settled me in the home of His Name. ॥4॥21॥90॥
By the sight of the Guru a person puts out the fire of craving.
On meeting the Guru he kills his pride.
In the Guru's company the mind does not waver,
for in the Guru's shelter one keeps uttering the life-giving Word. ॥1॥
ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਜਾ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
The whole world appears as the form of the ever-abiding Lord when one is dyed in His love,
ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਤਿ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and the heart is cooled and at peace when through the Guru one comes to know God. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
By the Guru's grace one repeats God's Name.
By the Guru's grace one sings God's praise.
By the Guru's grace all one's sorrows are wiped out,
for by the Guru's grace one gets free of Maya's bonds. ॥2॥
ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ; ਮਿਟੇ ਮੋਹ ਭਰਮ ॥
By the Guru's grace, attachment to Maya and wandering after it come to an end.
Bathing in the dust of the Guru's feet is the essence of all religious duties.
When the holy are kind to someone, God too becomes kind to him.
My very life is given over at the feet of the holy. ॥3॥
When I remember the merciful Lord, the treasury of mercy,
then my heart finds its rest in the company of the holy.
ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਕਉ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਦਇਆ ॥
God has shown kindness to me, who have no virtue,
O Nanak, and in the company of the holy I have begun repeating the Name. ॥4॥22॥91॥
Those who have remembered God in the company of the holy,
to whom the Guru has given the Name alone as mantra,
have shed their pride and become free of enmity.
Through all eight watches worship the Guru's feet. ॥1॥
My wicked and senseless thinking has gone
ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸੁਣਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
ever since I heard God's praise with my ears. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The treasury of poise, peace and bliss,
the Protector, has in the end kept safe those who heard His praise.
Their pain, suffering, fears and doubts are all destroyed.
In His kindness God ends their coming and going. ॥2॥
He who Himself sees, speaks and hears in all,
ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਨ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
who is always beside you: worship Him, O my mind.
The one in whom, by the Guru's grace, the light of spiritual life dawns
sees the One, the treasury of virtues, pervading everywhere. ॥3॥
Those who utter His praise and those who hear it all become pure in life,
they who sing God's virtues day after day.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
Says Nanak: the one to whom You are kind, Lord,
ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ; ਸਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੯੨॥
all that person's labour bears fruit. ॥4॥23॥92॥
The Guru breaks a person's bonds and has him remember God.
In his mind an unshakeable attention takes hold.
Troubles are wiped away and one lives in peace.
Such a giver is the Guru said to be. ॥1॥
He is the giver of bliss because he has one repeat the Name,
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and in his kindness joins one to God. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
The one to whom God is kind, He Himself brings to the Guru.
That person gains every treasure from the Guru.
He gives up self-regard, and his coming and going ends.
In the Guru's company he forms a deep bond with the supreme God. ॥2॥
God grows kind to His servant.
184: The one Sustainer alone becomes the servant's support.
He is fixed on the One, and love for the One alone rests in his mind.
ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ; ਜਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
In the servant's heart God's Name is every treasure. ॥3॥
His love for the supreme God holds firm,
his life becomes pure and his way of living steady,
once the perfect Guru has removed the darkness within him.
Nanak's God is beyond the beyond and without limit. ॥4॥24॥93॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਤਰੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
The one in whose mind God dwells crosses over.
When by His bounty the Name is received,
ਦੂਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਕਛੁ ਭਉ; ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
no pain, illness or fear can take hold of that person,
for he keeps repeating in his heart God's life-giving Name. ॥1॥
The supreme God, the highest Lord, should be remembered.
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ; ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
This understanding is received from the perfect Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He who can do all and cause all to be done, the home of kindness,
who is out of reach, beyond the senses, and whose virtues never end:
remember Him, O my mind, by following the perfect Guru's teaching. ॥2॥
He in whose service lie all treasures,
by whose worship honour is gained,
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ; ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
and service done to whom never goes to waste:
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
for ever and ever keep singing that Lord's praises. ॥3॥
Show mercy, O God who knows the heart,
O treasury of comforts, unseen Master.
All creatures rest in Your shelter.
O Nanak, pray: may I receive Your Name, for that is my honour. ॥4॥25॥94॥
ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
He in whose hands is the way of life of every being,
remember Him, the Master of the masterless.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ; ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
When God comes to dwell in the mind, every sorrow leaves.
ਭੈ ਸਭ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥
Through God's Name all fears are destroyed. ॥1॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ; ਭਉ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਾ ਮਾਨਹਿ ॥
Why do you hold any fear but of God?
ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ; ਕਾਹੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Forgetting God, what else do you take for comfort? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Remember Him who upholds the many earths and skies,
whose light shines in all beings,
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਖਸ; ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
and whose gift no one can undo.
Whoever keeps remembering God becomes fearless. ॥2॥
Through all eight watches keep remembering God's Name.
This itself is the bathing at many places of pilgrimage.
If you take shelter in the supreme God,
ਕੋਟਿ ਕਲੰਕ; ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
crores of your sins are wiped out in an instant. ॥3॥
God depends on no one; He is the King complete in all virtues.
God's servants keep an unshakeable trust in Him.
Through the perfect Guru, God gives His hand and saves them.
O Nanak, the supreme God holds all power. ॥4॥26॥95॥
The one whose mind, by the Guru's grace, joins itself to the Name
wakes up, though asleep through birth after birth.
He utters God's life-giving virtues and the hymns of His praise,
the person who receives the perfect Guru's fine teaching. ॥1॥
Remembering God, he has gained every comfort,
ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ; ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸਬਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and has all the joys of poise both within his heart and in his dealings with the world. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He has formed a deep bond with the very Lord who made him.
God, in His mercy, has Himself joined him to Himself.
The one whom God takes by the arm and makes His own
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ; ਸਦਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੨॥
always speaks of God's praises and repeats His Name. ॥2॥
For him the Name is mantra, charm, medicine and rite of atonement,
185: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
The Lord's Name alone becomes the support of that person's life and breath.
Steeped in the Lord's love, he gains the wealth of the Name that stays with him always.
Whoever keeps the Guru's company crosses this world-ocean so hard to cross. ॥3॥
O saints, become one family and sit together in spiritual bliss.
ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਓ; ਜਾ ਕਾ. ਨਾਹਿ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
Whoever sits in such company has earned the Lord's wealth that cannot be reckoned.
The Guru gives it to the one in whose fortune it is written.
O Nanak, no one at the Guru's door goes away empty. ॥4॥27॥96॥
Writing God's praises, your hands become pure at once,
and your snares of Maya are taken away.
Keep singing God's praises with your tongue at all times,
O my brother, my friend, and you will enjoy spiritual bliss. ॥1॥
With the pen of your attention, on the paper of your conduct, with the ink of your mind, write the Name of God;
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ; ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
write the word of praise that gives spiritual life. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
By this work your vices will flee from within.
Remembering God, spiritual death no longer remains for you.
ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੇ ਦੂਤ; ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
The messengers that bring a person under the righteous judge's power cannot even look at you,
you will not be drowned in Maya, and nothing will be able to entice you. ॥2॥
You yourself will be saved from vices, and in your company the world too will cross over.
Repeat God's Name; keep remembering the One Creator.
Earn the wealth of remembrance yourself and teach others too;
make God's Name dwell in your heart. ॥3॥
The one on whose forehead this treasure is written by God's grace,
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
Whoever sings the Lord's praises all eight watches,
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੯੭॥
Says Nanak: I am a sacrifice to him. ॥4॥28॥97॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
Gauri Guareri · Chaupade Dupade · Guru Arjan
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
What must in the end belong to another, we take to be our own,
ਜੋ ਤਜਿ ਛੋਡਨ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੧॥
and our mind stays absorbed in that which must at last be left behind. ॥1॥
Tell me, how can we meet the Master,
ਜੋ ਬਿਬਰਜਤ; ਤਿਸ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
when our love is for the Maya we have been warned against? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਝੂਠੁ ਬਾਤ; ਸਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
What is false we have taken to be true,
ਸਤਿ ਹੋਵਨੁ; ਮਨਿ ਲਗੈ ਨ. ਰਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
and death, which is sure to come, does not settle in our mind at all. ॥2॥
We have taken the wrong road of life and walk a crooked course.
Leaving the straight way, we weave the fabric of our life backwards. ॥3॥
ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਕਾ; ਖਸਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
God Himself is Master of both sides, the good and the bad.
ਜਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ; ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੨੯॥੯੮॥
O Nanak, the one God joins to His feet is saved from the wrong side. ॥4॥29॥98॥
In this world beset by troubles, wife and husband come together through past ties.
As long as the Lord's order lasts, they enjoy the world's things together. ॥1॥
By burning in the fire the loving husband is not found;
ਕਿਰਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ; ਸਤੀ ਉਠਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
for the sake of a union that can be had, the wife rises and becomes a sati, burning in vain. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One sees another and burns through the stubbornness of the mind,
ਪ੍ਰਿਅ. ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ; ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
yet does not gain the beloved's company, and only wanders through many births. ॥2॥
The wife who lives in the way of a sweet nature and obeys her beloved's command,
ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਰੀ ਕਉ; ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਮਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
that woman is not touched by the pain of Death's messengers. ॥3॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਿਨਿ. ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Says Nanak: the one who has taken her own husband as her one master, as the devotee's husband is the one God,
she is the true sati, she is fortunate, and she is accepted in the Lord's presence. ॥4॥30॥99॥
Through the eternal Lord's Name we are growing rich and fortunate,
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ; ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
as we sing the Lord's praises, stay in stillness of mind and remain absorbed in love. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
186: ਪੀਊ ਦਾਦੇ ਕਾ; ਖੋਲਿ ਡਿਠਾ ਖਜਾਨਾ ॥
When I opened and looked into the treasure of the word of all the Gurus from Guru Nanak on,
then my mind was filled with a store of spiritual bliss. ॥1॥
ਰਤਨ ਲਾਲ; ਜਾ ਕਾ. ਕਛੂ ਨ ਮੋਲੁ ॥
In it I saw priceless jewels and rubies of the Lord's praise,
stores filled full that never run out and cannot be weighed. ॥2॥
Those who come together in the holy company, use these stores themselves and share them with others,
never run short of this treasure; it only grows more and more. ॥3॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥
Says Nanak: the one on whose forehead the writ of God's grace is written,
he alone is made a sharer in this treasure of praise. ॥4॥31॥100॥
ਡਰਿ ਡਰਿ ਮਰਤੇ; ਜਬ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
As long as we think God lives somewhere far away, we keep dying a spiritual death in dread of the world's pains.
When we saw Him pervading everything, the fear came to an end. ॥1॥
I am a sacrifice to my true Guru;
ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ; ਸਰਪਰ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
he does not abandon us as we drown, and surely carries us across. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਦੂਖੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਸੋਗੁ; ਬਿਸਰੈ ਜਬ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
Pain, disease and worry strike only when the Name is forgotten.
ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ; ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
When we sing songs of the Lord's praise, the mind stays in bliss for ever. ॥2॥
One should neither slander anyone nor flatter anyone.
Giving up worldly pride, one should keep the Lord's feet in the heart. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: keep the Guru's teaching strung in your mind,
and you will enjoy bliss in the court of the eternal Lord. ॥4॥32॥101॥
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮੀਤੁ; ਸਾਜਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਮੀਆ ॥
The one who comes to trust that his friend and companion, God, is present everywhere,
ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ; ਕਹੁ ਕਾ ਕੀ ਕਮੀਆ ॥੧॥
tell me, what can that person lack? ॥1॥
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
The one whose love is joined to God,
ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
his every pain, every ache and every wandering doubt is removed. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾ ਕਉ. ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ; ਹੈ ਆਇਓ ॥
The one who has come to know the joy of the Lord's Name
does not cling to the tastes of other worldly things. ॥2॥
The one whose spoken word is accepted in the Lord's presence
ਸੋ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ; ਨਦਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਵੈ ਤਲੈ ॥੩॥
is no longer dependent on anyone else. ॥3॥
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
The one who becomes a servant of God, whose creation this whole world is,
ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕਉ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩੩॥੧੦੨॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
The one in whose heart every pain and pleasure seems alike,
no worry can ever weigh him down. ॥1॥
In the heart of the Lord's devotee there is always stillness of mind and bliss;
the devotee walks only in the Lord's command. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
The one in whose mind the carefree Lord comes to dwell,
is never touched by any worry. ॥2॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
The one whose mind is rid of wandering,
ਤਾ ਕੈ; ਕਛੂ ਨਾਹੀ ਡਰੁ ਜਮਾ ॥੩॥
has no fear of death left in him at all. ॥3॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
The one in whose heart the Guru has fixed the Name of God,
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੩੪॥੧੦੩॥
Says Nanak: all treasures, as it were, come within him. ॥4॥34॥103॥
ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪ ਕਾ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਨਾ ॥
In the mind where springs of praise flow, God of unreachable form comes to dwell.
But only a rare person has understood this, by the Guru's grace. ॥1॥
The joy of the nectar springs of stillness and praise
ਜਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ; ਤਿਸੁ ਲੈ ਭੁੰਚਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
is enjoyed by the one in whose fortune it is written. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Through the word of unbroken praise, that place in the heart becomes wondrously beautiful.
God Himself is enchanted by its fixed attention. ॥2॥
There are many endless arenas of stillness of mind,
where the saints stay absorbed, joined to the feet of the Supreme Lord. ॥3॥
There endless joy remains, and no other worry of any kind can touch.
ਸੋ ਘਰੁ; ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਆ ॥੪॥੩੫॥੧੦੪॥
The Guru has given that spiritual abode to Nanak too. ॥4॥35॥104॥
O Lord, which form of Yours should I meditate on?
By what practice of yoga should I bring my body under control? ॥1॥
187: ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨੁ; ਜੋ ਤੁਝੁ ਲੈ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
O Supreme Lord, which of Your virtues should I take up to sing Your praise,
and with what words should I please You? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
O Supreme Lord, what worship of Yours should I perform?
ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਬਿਧਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਉ ॥੨॥
O Lord, what is the way by which I may cross the world-ocean? ॥2॥
What is the austerity by which one may be called a true ascetic?
ਕਵਨੁ ਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਇ ॥੩॥
What is the Name by which one can wash away the filth of pride? ॥3॥
ਗੁਣ ਪੂਜਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਗਲ ਘਾਲ ॥
O Nanak, the praises sung, the worship, the knowledge and the attention, all that labour bears fruit for him
ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੪॥
on whom the Guru, being kind, bestows his grace and meets. ॥4॥
ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਗੁਨੁ; ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
His praise alone is accepted, he alone has come to know God,
ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਮਾਨਿ ਲੇਇ; ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੩੬॥੧੦੫॥
whose prayer God, the giver of all comforts, grants. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥36॥105॥
ਆਪਨ ਤਨੁ ਨਹੀ; ਜਾ ਕੋ ਗਰਬਾ ॥
This body you take pride in is not your own.
Kingdom, land and wealth are not your own either. ॥1॥
To whom are you clinging? None of them is your own.
ਆਪਨ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Only the Name, received from the true Guru, is your own. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Son, wife and brother are not your own;
ਇਸਟ ਮੀਤ; ਆਪ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
nor are dear friends, father or mother anyone's own for ever. ॥2॥
Gold, silver and riches are not your own either.
Fine horses and fine elephants will not be of use to you for ever. ॥3॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
Says Nanak: the one whom the Guru in his grace has joined to God,
ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ; ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩੭॥੧੦੬॥
whose companion the Lord has become, to him everything belongs. ॥4॥37॥106॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਊਪਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਥੇ ॥
The Guru's feet rest on my forehead,
ਤਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਰੇ; ਸਗਲੇ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੧॥
and through them all my pains are gone. ॥1॥
I am a sacrifice to my true Guru;
ਆਤਮ ਚੀਨਿ; ਪਰਮ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
examining my own spiritual life, I enjoy the highest bliss. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਚਰਣ ਰੇਣੁ; ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
The one on whose forehead the dust of the Guru's feet has fallen
has given up all his proud thinking. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਲਗੋ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
The Guru's word feels sweet in my mind,
and through it I behold the Supreme Lord. ॥3॥
The Guru is the giver of all comforts; the Guru is the Creator's own form.
O Nanak, the Guru is the support of my soul and my breath. ॥4॥38॥107॥
ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਆਹਿ ॥
O my mind, long to meet that God
in whose house nothing at all is lacking. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ; ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੀਤ ॥
O my friend the mind, make a beloved like the Lord,
ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ; ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਦ ਚੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and keep that support of your breath ever strung in your mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਤੂੰ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਿ ॥
O my mind, serve and worship that God
who is the root of all, pervading all, beyond the beyond, and light itself. ॥2॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ; ਮਨ ਕਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਸਾ ॥
O mind, put your hope in that God
in whose help all beings have trusted from the very beginning. ॥3॥
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
The God whose love brings lasting spiritual bliss,
Nanak sings His praises, having met the Guru. ॥4॥39॥108॥
Whatever my friend God does, I accept,
and my friend's doings seem to me like comforts. ॥1॥
In my mind there is only this one support:
ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ; ਸੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that God, whose whole creation this is, is my friend. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
My friend God depends on no one;
by the Guru's grace my love for Him has formed. ॥2॥
My friend God knows every heart.
He is master of all powers, all-pervading, boundless, Lord of all. ॥3॥
O Lord, You are my master and I am Your servant.
188: O Nanak, only by being Your servant does one gain honour and greatness. ॥4॥40॥109॥
ਜਾ ਕਉ. ਤੁਮ ਭਏ; ਸਮਰਥ ਅੰਗਾ ॥
O Lord of all powers, the one You stand beside as helper,
no stain of vice can touch. ॥1॥
ਮਾਧਉ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਆਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥
O Lord of Maya, the one who hopes in You alone
ਤਾ ਕਉ; ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
no longer needs to hope in the world's help. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The one in whose heart the Master stays remembered,
ਜਾ ਕਉ; ਤੁਮ ਦੀਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧੀਰ ॥
O Lord, the one to whom You have given patience,
ਤਾ ਕੈ; ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪੀਰ ॥੩॥
no pain or trouble can come near. ॥3॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਮੈ. ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Says Nanak: I have found that Guru
who has shown me the all-pervading, boundless Lord. ॥4॥41॥110॥
This rare human body is gained by great good fortune.
ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ; ਤੇ ਆਤਮ ਘਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
Those who do not repeat the Name bring spiritual death on themselves. ॥1॥
ਮਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ; ਜਿਨਾ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਰਾਮ ॥
Those who forget God surely die a spiritual death,
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨ; ਜੀਵਨ ਕਉਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
for without the Name a human life is of no use. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Those who miss the Name spread out a show of eating, drinking, playing and laughing,
but what use is it to adorn a corpse? ॥2॥
Those who do not hear the praise of the Lord of highest bliss
ਪਸੁ ਪੰਖੀ; ਤ੍ਰਿਗਦ ਜੋਨਿ ਤੇ ਮੰਦਾ ॥੩॥
are worse than beasts, birds and creatures that crawl. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: the one in whose heart the Guru has made his teaching firm,
only the Name of God stays fixed in his heart. ॥4॥42॥111॥
ਕਾ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ; ਕਾ ਕੋ ਬਾਪ ॥
In truth no one is anyone's mother for ever, and no one anyone's father.
All these relations are not lasting; they are relations in name only. ॥1॥
O fool, why do you wail as if talking in your sleep?
ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ; ਹੁਕਮਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You have come into the world through past ties, by the Lord's command. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
All beings are of one clay, and the one light of the Creator is in all;
in all is the one breath; who should weep for whom? ॥2॥
yet this soul is not one that dies. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: those whose doors, locked by attachment to Maya, the Guru has opened,
have become free of the bonds of attachment, and all their wandering displays have come to an end. ॥4॥43॥112॥
Those who look great in the world through wealth and power
are kept down by the disease of worry. ॥1॥
No one is truly great through greatness gained by Maya.
ਸੋ ਵਡਾ; ਜਿਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He alone is great who has fixed his attention on God. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The landowner fights and quarrels with others for his land every day.
In the end he leaves it and departs, yet his craving is never quenched. ॥2॥
Says Nanak: having reflected, we have found this truth,
that without worship of the Lord there is no release from attachment to Maya. ॥3॥44॥113॥
God's Name alone is the right road of life; the Name is the true bathing at pilgrim places.
The one in whose heart the Name dwells finds every effort free of flaw. ॥1॥
Their honour stayed whole, for the infallible Guru kept it,
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ; ਜਨ ਤਾਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
those who held to the shelter of the Supreme Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The one in the Lord's shelter enjoys lasting bliss and lives a contented life.
For him that shelter is the flawless austerity; he enjoys full kingship and stays joined to God's feet. ॥2॥
Those who walk on the Lord's path, though once fallen into vices, become pure.
They gain lasting honour, and their dealings with people stay graceful. ॥3॥
The Creator dwells always close beside that person
Says Nanak: whom my infallible true Guru meets. ॥4॥45॥114॥
ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ; ਮਿਟੇ ਅਘ ਕੋਟ ॥
By the dust of the Guru-saint's feet millions of sins are removed.
189: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਤੇ ਛੋਟ ॥੧॥
By the Guru-saint's grace one is released from the round of birth and death. ॥1॥
The sight of the Guru-saint is the complete bathing at pilgrim places.
ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ; ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the Guru-saint's grace the Name can be repeated. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In the Guru-saint's company pride is removed,
and the One Lord alone is seen everywhere. ॥2॥
The one on whom the Guru-saint is pleased brings the five under his control,
and gathers in his heart the Name that gives spiritual life. ॥3॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਮ ॥
Says Nanak: the one whose fortune is great
alone comes to touch the Guru's feet. ॥4॥46॥115॥
Singing the Lord's praises, the lotus of the heart blossoms;
remembering the Lord, every kind of fear is gone. ॥1॥
ਸਾ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰੀ; ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Count that understanding flawless by which a person sings the Lord's praises;
ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ; ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
it arises in one who by great fortune gains the Guru's company. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In the Guru's company the treasure of the Name is found,
and in the Guru's company all tasks are brought to completion. ॥2॥
Through devotion to the Lord a human birth becomes fruitful,
but repeating the Name comes only by the Guru's grace. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: only that person is accepted
ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
The one whose mind is dyed in the One Lord alone
He sees no one anywhere but God,
the Creator who can do all things and has all beings do them. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਨਹਿ ਕਮਾਵੈ; ਮੁਖਿ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ॥
The one who earns remembrance with his whole mind and speaks the Lord's Name with his mouth
ਸੋ ਜਨੁ; ਇਤ ਉਤ. ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ॥੨॥
never wavers, neither here nor hereafter. ॥2॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ; ਸੋ ਸਚ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
The one who has the wealth of the Lord's Name is a banker who stays a banker for ever.
The perfect Guru has established his credit. ॥3॥
The one who has met the all-pervading Lord, the support of all life,
Says Nanak: he has attained the highest spiritual state. ॥4॥48॥117॥
In the devotee's heart the Name of God is the support of his life;
the Name alone is his wealth, and the Name alone his trade. ॥1॥
The one who holds the Name gains greatness and earns honour,
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the one to whom the Lord Himself in His mercy has it given. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Name of God is the source of bliss in the devotee's heart.
The one dyed in the Name is the true devotee, accepted in the Lord's presence. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
The Lord's Name gives support to His servant,
and with every breath the servant keeps the Name safe in his heart. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: the one whose fortune is great,
his mind alone is won over by the Name. ॥4॥49॥118॥
Since by the Guru-saint's grace I have been remembering the Lord's Name,
my mind, once running after Maya, has been satisfied. ॥1॥
Singing His praises, I have found God, the giver of bliss.
ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ; ਮੇਰੀ ਹਤੀ ਬਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My running about has ended, and the demon of craving is dead. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Meditating on the beautiful feet of God,
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਤੇ; ਮਿਟੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
through remembering the Lord my every worry has gone. ॥2॥
ਸਭ ਤਜਿ ਅਨਾਥੁ; ਏਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
When I, helpless, left all other supports and came to the shelter of the One,
then, resting in stillness of mind, I gained that highest place. ॥3॥
My pain, my wandering and my fear have all run away;
O Nanak, the Creator has come to dwell in my mind. ॥4॥50॥119॥
ਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਟਹਲ; ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
With my hands I serve, and with my tongue I sing His praises,
190: and with these feet I walk on the Lord's path. ॥1॥
O my mind, this human birth is a fine time, the time for remembering God;
ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ; ਭੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
remembering the Name in it, one crosses over the many fears of the world. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
With your own eyes behold the Gurmukhs,
and keep writing the remembrance of the eternal Lord within your mind. ॥2॥
Go to the Guru's company and listen to songs of God's praise,
and so drive out the dread of spiritual death that casts one into birth and death. ॥3॥
Keep the Lord's lovely feet set in your heart.
O Nanak, this human body is hard to come by: carry it across. ॥4॥51॥120॥
The one on whom God bestows His mercy,
that person utters the Name with his tongue. ॥1॥
Forgetting God, the dread and pain of the world take hold,
ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ; ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
but remembering the Name, all wandering goes and every fear flees. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਣੈ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
One who hears the Lord's praise and sings the Lord's praise,
ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਦੂਖੁ; ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
no pain comes near that person. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਰਤ; ਜਨੁ ਸੋਹੈ ॥
Doing the Lord's service and worship, a person's life grows beautiful,
ਤਾ ਕਉ; ਮਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ. ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ॥੩॥
for the fire of craving for Maya cannot touch him. ॥3॥
ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
The one in whose mind, heart and mouth dwells the Name of the merciful Lord,
O Nanak, has cast off all the other entanglements of Maya. ॥4॥52॥121॥
Give up the idea that you are very wise and clever,
and take the support of the perfect Guru. ॥1॥
ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ; ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
Singing God's praises, he finds peace and all his pains are gone,
ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the one who meets the perfect Guru and fixes his attention on God's feet. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ॥
The one to whom the Guru has given the mantra of God's Name,
his grief is wiped away and every care has lifted. ॥2॥
Meeting the Guru, the source of mercy, spiritual joys arise,
and in his kindness the Guru cuts the snares of Maya that bring spiritual death. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: the one who finds the perfect Guru,
ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ; ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੫੩॥੧੨੨॥
through that Guru Maya can no longer hold sway over him. ॥4॥53॥122॥
The perfect Guru has Himself saved the one who lives by the Guru,
but one who follows his own mind keeps feeling the heat of the vices. ॥1॥
O my friends, keep the Guru ever in mind,
and your faces will shine in God's court. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Keep the Guru's feet lodged in your heart.
The Guru will end your pains, kill your enemies and finish the witch Maya. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
The Guru's word alone is the companion who stays with you.
Holding the Guru's word in the heart, all people become compassionate. ॥3॥
When the perfect Guru showed me mercy,
says Nanak, the labour of my life bore fruit. ॥4॥54॥123॥
Like cattle filling their bellies, he eats many tasty things,
and like a thief caught in the act he is bound ever tighter by the rope of attachment. ॥1॥
The body of one who stays away from the company of the holy is a corpse.
ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ; ਜੋਨੀ ਦੁਖ ਖੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He stays in the round of birth and death, and the pains of births weaken his spiritual life. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He wears many fine clothes and the poor keep their distance from him,
as from a scarecrow set up in a field to frighten. ॥2॥
The bodies of all other creatures are of some use.
If a person does not repeat the Name, his coming into the world is in vain. ॥3॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
Says Nanak: those on whom God is merciful
join the company of the holy and worship the Sustainer of the world. ॥4॥55॥124॥
